photo.title: Princess Fe Ditamina, daughter of Fon Galega I with two small girls with beaded 'ngwasi' and other dance gear, seated outside house. Objects said to have been made from beads etc guven by Zintgraff in 1893 ?
Ga of Bali-Gham wearing traditional royal costume.

The aged Fonggiam 'mfonto' seated. Wearing gown of floral European fabric and high status ornaments. Holding brass bowled pipe in form of a German soldier and incised cow-horn drinking vessel. In foreground carved stools and fly-whisk.
